idea-plugin.name: SpiceDB
idea-plugin.description:
Community plugin for SpiceDB schema (.zed) files. Not affiliated with AuthZed.

Features

  • Full PSI parser for the SpiceDB schema language, including composable schema syntax (partials, splats, use/import, caveats, wildcards)
  • Go to Definition (Ctrl+Click) for type references, subject relations (type#relation), arrow targets, caveats, partials, and local members
  • Find Usages for definitions, partials, relations, permissions, and caveats
  • Syntax and semantic highlighting
  • Brace matching and comment support

SpiceDB

SpiceDB is an open source, Google Zanzibar-inspired database for storing and computing permissions data. It provides a schema language for defining permission models.
